semantic_input.title: Monster Train
semantic_input.short_description: Monster Train is a strategic roguelike deck building game with a twist. Set on a train to hell, you’ll use tactical decision making to defend multiple vertical battlegrounds. With real time competitive multiplayer and endless replayability, Monster Train is always on time.

semantic_input.title: Monaco: What's Yours Is Mine
semantic_input.short_description: Monaco: What's Yours Is Mine is a single player or co-op heist game.  Assemble a crack team of thieves, case the joint, and pull off the perfect heist.

semantic_input.title: The Wild at Heart
semantic_input.short_description: Wield an ever-growing herd of quirky creatures to rebuild broken paths, battle perilous beasts, and solve peculiar puzzles in a rich, interconnected world. Join two young runaways as they unravel the mysteries of a lost realm in this nostalgic storybook fantasy!

semantic_input.title: DEEEER Simulator: Your Average Everyday Deer Game
semantic_input.short_description: Put simply, DEEEER Simulator is a “Slow-Life Town Destruction Game”. You can spend your days enjoying a nice, relaxed frolic here and there together with the other animals around town, or you can choose to relieve some stress and absolutely destroy the town and everything in it.

semantic_input.title: Unpacking
semantic_input.short_description: Unpacking is a zen puzzle game about the familiar experience of pulling possessions out of boxes and fitting them into a new home. Part block-fitting puzzle, part home decoration, you are invited to create a satisfying living space while learning clues about the life you’re unpacking.

semantic_input.title: Shadow Warrior 3: Definitive Edition
semantic_input.short_description: Take an adrenaline-fueled journey through a mythical Japanese realm in the Definitive Edition of Shadow Warrior 3, packed with new features, and enjoy an ultraviolent blend of fast-paced gunplay, razor-sharp melee combat, and spectacular free-running movement.

semantic_input.title: Nightmare Reaper
semantic_input.short_description: Blast through a cursed nightmare solo or with up to 3 friends. A retro-inspired FPS where looter shooter weapons meets boomer shooter chaos and rogue-lite elements.

semantic_input.title: Dark Light
semantic_input.short_description: Dark Light is a post-apocalyptic cyberpunk action-platformer with intense hack'n slash combat. Explore the unknown, enhance your abilities with cyberwares, and face off against supernatural entities to seal the Dark Void and end the eternal darkness.

semantic_input.title: The Gunk
semantic_input.short_description: The Gunk is an action-adventure game in which you play as Rani, part of our duo of gritty space haulers. As they’re struggling to bring in funds, they chance upon an untouched planet brimming with life. They came in search of valuable resources, and it looks like they’ve hit the jackpot…

semantic_input.title: White Shadows
semantic_input.short_description: The wolves are watching! Venture through a captivating but brutal dystopia where our young adventurer Ravengirl will travel through this huge city’s brightest highs and delve to its darkest depths on her perilous journey of discovery and finding her destiny where hope seems in short supply.

semantic_input.title: Paper Dolls: Original / 纸人
semantic_input.short_description: Paper Dolls Original is a first-person horror adventure game steeped in Eastern culture. You act a man who is separated from his daughter after a car accident. When he awakes, he finds himself in a deserted Asian mansion. Find your daughter and unveil a terrifying story buried for a hundred years

semantic_input.title: Selfloss
semantic_input.short_description: Selfloss  is an emotional exploration game filled with rich lore, set in a whale-worshipping, Slavic-inspired world. Embark on the journey of the healer, Kazimir, and his magical staff as he fights a mysterious Miasma in search of a ritual to cure his wounded soul.

semantic_input.title: Landlord's Super
semantic_input.short_description: Your quintessential construction simulator is here. Take a dodgy loan, restore a property, move in the locals, attend to their grievances, then celebrate with a pint in this fully-simulated, open-world 1980's Britain.

semantic_input.title: Black Skylands
semantic_input.short_description: Become the captain of an airship and explore the world of the skies, gather resources and build powerful weapons, uncover ancient secrets and fight beneath your ship's sails.

semantic_input.title: Garfield Kart - Furious Racing
semantic_input.short_description: Garfield, the famous lasagna-loving cat is back to take on Jon, Odie and company in a no-holds-barred racing game!

semantic_input.title: Atelier Ayesha: The Alchemist of Dusk DX
semantic_input.short_description:
"The promise begins."
The "Dusk" series, a trilogy of RPG titles from Gust's popular Atelier series, tells the story of a world on the verge ruin, told from the perspective of its unique characters.
The 1st title in the series "Atelier Ayesha" is now available as a deluxe version.

semantic_input.title: Atelier Escha & Logy: Alchemists of the Dusk Sky DX
semantic_input.short_description:
"The promise is entrusted to two alchemists..."
The "Dusk" series, a trilogy of RPG titles from Gust's popular Atelier series, tells the story of a world on the verge ruin, told from the perspective of its unique characters.
The 2nd title in the series "Atelier Escha & Logy" is now available as a deluxe version.

semantic_input.title: ATOM RPG Trudograd
semantic_input.short_description: ATOM RPG: Trudograd is a turn-based post-apocalyptic roleplaying game, which continues the story of ATOM RPG as a stand-alone sequel/expansion, and follows the traditions set by classic cRPGs such as the early Fallout and Wasteland titles.

semantic_input.title: Gas Station Simulator
semantic_input.short_description: Buy an abandoned gas station and restore it to its full glory. Renovate, upgrade and expand upon the offered services to keep up with your clients demands.

semantic_input.title: Lake
semantic_input.short_description:
It's 1986 - Meredith Weiss takes a break from her career in the big city to deliver mail in her hometown.
How will she experience two weeks in beautiful Providence Oaks, with its iconic lake and quirky community? And what will she do next?
  
It's up to you.

semantic_input.title: The Complex
semantic_input.short_description: After a major bio-weapon attack on London, two scientists find themselves in a locked-down laboratory with time, and air, running out. The Complex is an interactive sci-fi thriller movie where your decisions lead to one of eight suspenseful endings.

semantic_input.title: Lifeless Moon
semantic_input.short_description: During an expedition to the Moon, two astronauts find themselves in a familiar town back on Earth. They soon discover the town is the beginning of a strange and mysterious journey...

semantic_input.title: Roadwarden
semantic_input.short_description: Roadwarden is an illustrated text-based RPG that uses isometric pixel art and combines mechanics borrowed from RPGs, Visual Novels, adventure games and interactive fiction.

semantic_input.title: Yes, Your Grace
semantic_input.short_description: These are troubling times, Your Grace. The petitioners’ petty matters exceed our limited resources, to say nothing of the war. A careful balance must be struck. Your throne awaits.

semantic_input.title: Going Under
semantic_input.short_description: Going Under is a satirical dungeon crawler about exploring the cursed ruins of failed tech startups. As an unpaid intern in the dystopian city of Neo-Cascadia, you’ll wield office junk as weaponry as you make your way through the offbeat procedural dungeons beneath your company campus.

semantic_input.title: Heavenly Bodies
semantic_input.short_description: Wrangle the hands and arms of a 1970s space cosmonaut and push, pull and twist your way through an increasingly precarious range of physically simulated stellar scenarios, where without gravity, nothing is still, nothing is secure, and nothing is simple.

semantic_input.title: Crown Trick
semantic_input.short_description: Enter a labyrinth that moves as you move, where mastering the elements is key to defeating enemies and uncovering the mysteries of this underground world. With a new experience awaiting every time you enter the dungeon, let the power bestowed by the crown guide you in this challenging adventure!

semantic_input.title: Wingspan
semantic_input.short_description: Wingspan is a relaxing, award-winning strategy card game about birds for 1 to 5 players. Each bird you play extends a chain of powerful combinations in one of your three habitats. Your goal is to discover and attract the best birds to your network of wildlife preserves.
